title: Easton realization, GCH, and SCH
deferred_material: Easton's realization theorem for continuum functions on regular cardinals; consistency or independence results about GCH and SCH
supporting_development_needed: Use the existing model-witness criteria, membership semantics, generic-extension theorem and elementary ccc preservation as foundations. Develop the higher chain-condition, closure and iteration framework needed for Easton realization, and supply the relevant constructibility/forcing witnesses for GCH or SCH claims. Necessary continuum inequalities and elementary ccc preservation alone do not establish those realization or independence theorems.
